Color identity: RG | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite combat damage; Infinite combat phases; Infinite death triggers; Infinite mana creatures you control can produce; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite untap of creatures you control; Infinite creature tokens with haste
Start: Breath of Fury (battlefield: attached to any other creature you control  ); Tervigon (battlefield: with power 1 or greater); Tannuk, Steadfast Second (battlefield)
Prerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.

  Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
  Repeat each combat phase.

Produces: Near-infinite creature ETB; Near-infinite creature LTB; Near-infinite combat damage; Near-infinite combat phases; Near-infinite death triggers; Near-infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Near-infinite mana creatures you control can produce; Near-infinite untap of creatures you control
Start: Raph & Mikey, Troublemakers (battlefield); Breath of Fury (battlefield: attached to another creature you control); Tuktuk Rubblefort (battlefield)
Prerequisites: There are creature cards in your library.
  An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Steps: Declare Raph & Mikey and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
  Raph & Mikey triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
  Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
  Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, and then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
  Repeat each combat phase until you have no creatures left in your library.
Notes: The number of combat phases you can get will be equal to the number of creature you control (excluding those listed in this combo) plus the number of creatures in your library plus 1.
